mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_completions cp JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED'
AND c.classification_code LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
mapper.sql: COALESCE(( SELECT e.event_type = 'REVOKED' AND e.actor_id IS NOT NULL FROM tb_learning_badge_events e WHERE e.badge_id = tb_learning_badges.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ), FALSE) AS revoked_by_admin
mapper.select: SELECT id, definition_id, status, tier_level, credential_id, FALSE AS revoked_by_admin FROM tb_learning_badges WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ISSUED' AND definition_id IS NOT NULL AND credential_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_learning_badges SET status = 'ISSUED', revoked_at = NULL, course_id = #{courseId, jdbcType=OTHER}, tier_level = #{tierLevel, jdbcType=SMALLINT}, issued_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'REVOKED' AND credential_id IS NULL
